subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Future of AML
description: A fast breakdown of The Future of AML for builders.

hook.text: Current AML is built on rules from the 1970s. Criminals use 2024 technology. The gap is growing.

buildup.text: Next-generation AML combines AI, blockchain analytics, and real-time data sharing across institutions.

discovery.text: Some countries are testing shared utility models where banks pool resources for collective AML intelligence.

twist.text: The biggest barrier isn't technology — it's willingness to share data and change decades of siloed practices.

climax.text: AML must evolve from a compliance exercise to a crime-fighting system. Technology enables it; culture must follow.

punchline.text: 1970s rules. 2024 criminals. AML must catch up.

quiz.question: What is the biggest barrier to next-generation AML?
options: Willingness to share data and change siloed practices
